newsitem.title: GREECE: Athens bourse cancels trades, starts new session.
newsitem.headline: Athens bourse cancels trades, starts new session.

text.p: The Athens stock exchange cancelled all trades and will restart Monday's session again at 1:15 p.m. local until 3:30 p.m., bourse officials said.
A technical problem with the electronic trading system had share prices going awry and trading has halted after a delayed open.

"The session will start again at 1:15 p.m. local and it will be a normal session ending at 15:30. All trades that took place so far will be annulled," bourse official Tasos Sgouros told Reuters. --George Georgiopoulos, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
The Athens stock exchange cancelled all trades and resumed Monday's session at 1315 local but a technical problem with the electronic trading system had share prices going awry again.
It had failed to overcome similar trading problems in its delayed opening at 1100 local. --Dimitris Kontogiannis, Angelos Kiosklis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
